info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Expert Sales Support API enables businesses to modify specific sale records identified by a unique parameter. This API allows for patch updates, facilitating the adjustment of sale details such as pricing, promotions, or other relevant attributes. It's designed for financial institutions and retail platforms seeking to streamline their sales management processes. Typical consumers include developers integrating sales features into applications, enhancing user engagement through up-to-date sales information.

patch.summary: Update product expert sales support details.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details for the product expert sales support associated with the given product ID. Ensure all required fields are included in the request to successfully update the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the partial update of the product expert sales support details for a specific product identified by PROD-700045. Include only the fields that need to be updated, following the defined schema.

200.description: Successful update of the product details.
